4. Cameras + characters

To add your 2P character, basically just copy pico and change around the costumes and timings. It shouldn't be too difficult, depending on your animation cycles.

To setup the camera, go to the Camera script and copy/paste one of the song if statements for 1P and 2P, and then change the song name and X/Y settings to your liking.

3. Adding your song to the song list
Add your song's name (all lowercase) to _songlist. THIS MUST MATCH THE NAME YOU PUT FOR YOUR "IF" STATEMENTS. Then, add an extra line in _song_highscores and set it to 0.

zSJW2?n;dRy7On*h,ucR.text:
2. Importing and adding your song
Use this site to convert (no data is stored or shared):

https://cabalex.github.io/fnf-song-converter/

Once you have your output TXT, create a new list and import the TXT into it. It should work. Then, go to the songHandler and insert your song there; then, add your song and beatmap to the functions telling you to, and mess around with the multiplier to see what speed fits it best. If your song has a vocal track, add that in the vocalHandler as well.

You're almost done!

1. Making your beat map
Go to FNF's itch.io page (link in the description) and go to a song. There, press 7. It'll open up a level editor. There's guides and ways to mess around with said level editor, so I won't discuss how to use that here; but basically, just make a song.

Then, when you're done with your song, click Save, and it should download a JSON file. Keep this!
